The task at hand is narrower than all three: only the third axis, \\\"an adopter's own repository\\\" (i.e. the campaign tests this repository's own corpus/tooling only, never a corpus somebody else adopted and built), needs an obligation_record filed now, and it must be indexed from docs/spec/13-open-obligations.md, which is this repository's index of open obligations (id HW-REG-open-obligations). Use docs/obligations/0018-the-bundle-set-is-a-guess-about-how-adopters-cluster.md as the structural model: front matter needs status: current, status_since (use today, 2026-11-10), waiting_on: adopter, last_verified, summary, title, provenance block, and relations.traces_to pointing at HW-DR-0112 (this is the decision that names the debt). Body needs Context (quote/paraphrase the sentence from HW-DR-0112 and explain why the additive campaign's own-repository-only scope means this gap exists), Obligation (what the corpus owes: a reading of the campaign's actions against a real adopter's own repository, not just this one), and Discharge (what would close it — a run of the campaign, or an equivalent instrument, over a corpus someone else adopted and built, since right now nothing supplies that). After creating the record, add one line for it under \\\"## What waits on a first adopter\\\" in docs/spec/13-open-obligations.md, matching the existing bullet format and sorted by id among the existing bullets there. Do not touch the other two axes (corpus size, tasks outside governance) — they are out of scope for this task.       result: ""

      argument: "{\"command\":\"find . -maxdepth 2 -type d | sort\",\"description\":\"List top-level directories\"}"
      result: ""

      result: ""

      result: ""

      result: ""
